deployments_detail.use: Voice-based AI assistant enabling caregivers to input care data by speech instead of manual entry

Koala AI voice assistant: care professionals record clinical data (resident weight, blood glucose, observations) hands-free via voice commands instead of manual data entry, integrated into the Koala mobile companion app for facility staff. [Internal development (Clariane/Korian)]
deployments_detail.value: Rolled out across 185 Korian facilities in France

deployments_detail.use: Kaspard contactless, image-free fall detection: sensor reconstructs the room as a point cloud to detect falls or prolonged bed absence in real time and alert nursing staff. [Kaspard]
deployments_detail.value: End 2023: 15% of French facilities and 25% of Belgian sites equipped

deployments_detail.use: Lindera AI-based fall prevention mobile application analyzing residents' gait/mobility to assess fall risk in German care homes. [Lindera]
deployments_detail.value: Used by more than 80% of the German network

deployments_detail.use: Generative AI to summarize clinical handover/transmission notes for care staff, filtering by specialty so staff returning from absence can quickly grasp key patient information without missing critical items. [Generative AI (model not disclosed)]

Frailty prediction and prevention algorithms developed with CNES/MEDES and Artefact, analyzing resident data to predict fall risk and detect depression/mental-health risk for early intervention in elderly care. [Artefact; CNES/MEDES]
deployments_detail.value: Fall-prevention algorithms trained on data from 56,000+ residents; depression detection on 1.6 million records

deployments_detail.use: Koala digital ecosystem: integrated mobile workplace app for care teams handling telephony, documentation, care handovers, maintenance and cleaning monitoring in facilities. [Internal development (Clariane/Korian)]

AI-powered technology-monitoring/intelligence service delivering weekly structured summaries (key articles, studies, innovations, weak signals, recommendations) on AI in elderly care, combining automated AI collection/analysis with human editorial curation. [IF (if-innovation.fr)]
deployments_detail.value: Operated continuously over a one-year engagement

deployments_detail.use: Generative AI to automatically draft responses to Google reviews across Clariane's ~1,000 European establishments, handling high volumes of daily feedback including complaints. [Generative AI (model not disclosed)]
deployments_detail.value: ~1,000 European establishments; multiple reviews per day per facility

deployments_detail.use: Generative AI to consolidate and synthesize serious adverse event reports at group level, identifying priority areas for care-quality improvement across facilities. [Generative AI (model not disclosed)]
